findings.subject: /opt/old/a2dlc
findings.message: the pre-push hook runs /opt/old/a2dlc (0.0.9) but this is /usr/local/bin/a2dlc (0.1.0): a push is gated by the hook's build

findings.subject: a2dlc-engine-py:0.13
findings.message: the image of the python engine is not present locally
findings.fix: docker build -t a2dlc-engine-py:0.13 <a2dlc source>/engines/py, or point config.engines[].image at an image you can pull

findings.message: the repo has signed documents (.a2dlc/approvals.json) and no allowed signers are configured
findings.fix: set A2DLC_ALLOWED_SIGNERS to an allowed_signers file, or create ~/.config/a2dlc/allowed_signers
